prompt: For the binary_classification.py model, should we use LightGBM's built-in class_weight balancing or manually oversample the minority class? Decide which one to use, implement it, and log the decision so we remember why later.
assertions: A file matching docs/decisions/NNN-*.md is created
The decision file explains the choice between class_weight balancing and oversampling
Both options are mentioned, with the non-chosen one marked as an alternative
binary_classification.py is modified to implement the chosen approach
The user explicitly asked to log the decision, so this must not be skipped
